assessment.intent: To help landscaping companies prepare their websites for seasonal demand by choosing the right sales paths, mapping content to the calendar, and structuring pages for conversion.
assessment.specificity: High. The article gives distinct advice for maintenance versus project work, specific intake form guidance, a sample page architecture, and local search fundamentals.
assessment.evidence: Cites Google Business Profile local ranking guidance and uses one approved project example to support the structural advice.
assessment.voice: Michael's practical, conversational voice is largely intact. The fixes remove self-praise and soften absolute claims without changing the core recommendations.
assessment.usefulAsset: Yes. The article provides actionable, industry-specific advice that a busy owner can apply directly.
